title: 第四章 任务（下）
content_zh:
“你就是Z？”坐在那个中年男子身旁的一个年青人，脸上稚气未脱，确认着已经向艾妮尔伸出了手，“我是多力！请多多关照。”

    “嗯。”艾妮尔只是微微的向他点了点头，并没有伸出手，对方有点不好意思的收回了手，“这是战略策划员艾勒维格，他是佣兵兼杀手尼克，而他……呵呵！他到现在还没开过口。”

    “那还有一位呢？”艾妮尔随意的扫了这几位一眼，问。

    “还没到吧！反正我们在这里呆了很久了，没见到第五位。”多力十分开朗，又爱说话。

    “那现在……”艾妮尔说着转身爱莎，“可以开始了吗？”

    “这……”爱莎犹豫着，“队长说一定要等人齐了再出发。”

    “嗯。”艾妮尔没有什么意见，既然要等，那么就安静的等吧！可是这样的她，让多力更是难受，“不用吧！我还以为有个女孩子加入会好一些，可是……可是你怎么跟他一样，不说话，连表情都没有。”

    “我失忆了。”艾妮尔说了一句后，再也没有开口，她确实是没什么好说的。

    时间在一分一秒的过去，爱莎有些焦急的盯着门口，每见到有人进来都信心满满的想要向对方打招呼，可是最后她的“你好”还没说出去，对方已经走向了别的桌子，跟桌前的那些人说笑了起来。

    在坐的几位，其实也就那个叫多力的年青人比较多话，其余的人都不善于开口，目光一个比一个冰冷，不过此时的这些人中，最让艾妮尔在意的就是他，那个不知道名字的家伙。

    这么热的天，他整个裹在厚厚的大衣里，连脸都被大衣的领子遮去了一半，看不清楚，头发长长的，一直盖过了双眼，不过从发间射出的目光带着一股寒意，这个让艾妮尔有些在意。

    什么人的目光能比佣兵兼杀手的尼克还冷呢？

    “不好意思，我来晚了！”正当大家开始相互观察，并细细品味时，有人走进了这个地下酒馆，直向桌前而来。

    “萨尔……是你？”看到他的出现，艾妮尔不由的一惊。

    “是啊！不好吗？”萨尔笑了，温柔似水，眼中的血色也变得不再冰冷。

    “你说的工作就是这个？”艾妮尔想起那张留言。

    “不算是，我刚做完了前一份工作才赶来。”说着，萨尔转向桌前的他们，“不好意思，我来晚了，请大家原谅。”

    “没关系，没关系！”别人还没说什么，多力就招呼起来，很是热情。

    “好了，现在到齐了，爱莎，下一步？”艾妮尔压下心中的诧异，开始向着自己的目的跨出第一步。

    “现在请跟我走，我会送你们去机场，那里一切已经准备好，明天的这个时候，你们就会到达那个城市。”

    下面的事情比较顺利，爱莎将艾妮尔他们送到了机场，应该说是军用机场，在那里上了一架小型的军用飞机，飞机上的时间是平静而自由的，时间长了，多力与大家也混的熟了些，至少他们愿意与他说说话，他提的问题也会有人回答一两句。

    不过艾妮尔一直与他们保持着一定的距离，萨尔的出现，她开始怀疑这又是波伊的一个谎言，或者说陷阱。由于她的那双血眼，只要她不表示出热情，绝对不会有人主动走上去打扰她。

    “艾妮尔，怎么啦？出什么事了？”不过萨尔除外。

    “你为什么会在这里？”艾妮尔很想这么问，而她也就这么问了。

"Are you Z?" A young man sitting next to the middle-aged man, with a childish look on his face, confirmed that he had extended his hand to Enel, "I am Doli! Please take care of me."

    "Yes." Enel just nodded to him slightly, without extending her hand. The other party retracted her hand a little embarrassed, "This is the strategic planner Ellevig, he is the mercenary and killer Nick, and he... Haha! He hasn't spoken yet."

    "Then there is one more person?" Enel glanced at these people casually and asked.

    "Not yet! Anyway, we've been here for a long time and haven't seen the fifth one." Doli was very cheerful and talkative.

    "Now..." Enel said, turning to Elsa, "Can we start?"

    "This..." Aisha hesitated, "The captain said that we must wait until everyone is gathered before setting off."

    "Yes." Enel has no objection. Since you have to wait, then just wait quietly! But she was like this, which made Duoli feel even more uncomfortable, "No need! I thought it would be better if a girl joined, but... But why are you like him, silent, not even expression?"

    "I have lost my memory." After Enel said this, she never spoke again. She really had nothing to say.

    As time passed by, Aisha stared at the door anxiously, and every time she saw someone coming in, she confidently wanted to say hello to the other person, but in the end, before she could say "hello", the other person had already walked to another table and started joking with the people at the table.

    Among the people sitting there, only the young man named Duoli was the talkative one. The rest of them were not good at speaking, and their eyes were colder than the others. But among these people at this time, the one that Anel cared about the most was him, the guy whose name she didn't know.

    On such a hot day, he was completely wrapped in a thick coat, and even his face was half covered by the collar of the coat, making it difficult to see clearly. His hair was long and covered his eyes, but the gaze from his hair had a chill in it, which made Anel a little concerned.

    Who can have colder eyes than Nick, the mercenary and killer?

    "Sorry, I'm late!" Just as everyone started to observe each other and savor the food, someone walked into the underground tavern and came straight to the table.

    "Sal...is that you?" Enel couldn't help but be surprised when she saw his appearance.

    "Yes! Isn't that good?" Sal smiled, as gentle as water, and the blood in his eyes became no longer cold.

    "Is this the job you're talking about?" Enel thought of the message.

    "Not really, I just came here after finishing my previous job." As he said that, Sal turned to them at the table, "I'm sorry, I'm late, please forgive me."

    "It's okay, it's okay!" Duoli greeted him enthusiastically before anyone else said anything.

    "Okay, we're all here now, Aisha, what's the next step?" Enel suppressed the surprise in her heart and began to take the first step towards her goal.

    "Please follow me now. I will take you to the airport. Everything is ready there. You will arrive in that city at this time tomorrow."

    The next thing went relatively smoothly. Aisha sent Enel and the others to the airport, which should be said to be a military airport, where they boarded a small military plane. The time on the plane was calm and free. As time went by, Doli became more familiar with everyone. At least they were willing to talk to him, and some of his questions would be answered.

    However, Enel has always kept a certain distance from them. With the appearance of Sal, she began to suspect that this was another lie or a trap by Boy. Because of her bloody eyes, as long as she didn't show any enthusiasm, no one would take the initiative to disturb her.

    "Anel, what's the matter? What happened?" Except for Thrall.

    "Why are you here?" Enel wanted to ask, so she just asked.
